curiosities.1: Tomar was founded in 1160 by Dom Gualdim Pais, the Grand Master of the Knights Templar in Portugal?
curiosities.2: The Convent of Christ was classified as a World Heritage Site by UNESCO in 1983?
curiosities.3: The grandiose Festa dos Tabuleiros is one of the oldest in the country and takes place only every 4 years?
curiosities.4: The Chapter Window in the Convent of Christ is considered the ultimate masterpiece of the Manueline style?
curiosities.5: The Synagogue of Tomar is the oldest preserved Jewish temple in Portugal, built in the mid-15th century?
curiosities.6: The Sete Montes National Forest was the garden and retreat area for the monks of the Order of Christ?
curiosities.7: The Roda do Mouchão, a wooden waterwheel on the Nabão River, originally served to irrigate the city's crops?
curiosities.8: The Knights Templar were extinguished by the Pope in 1312, but reborn in Portugal in Tomar as the 'Order of Christ'?
curiosities.9: The famous Prince Henry the Navigator was Governor of the Order of Christ and lived in Tomar while planning the Discoveries?
curiosities.10: The Castle of Tomar was never conquered? In 1190, it heroically resisted a siege by the Moorish king Almanzor.
